title: Five-Token Base-100 Parser and Prefix Tree
what_it_does: Exact five-token base-100 route parser: parses '165876523' and '01|65|87|65|23' into tokens [1,65,87,65,23]; LEFT_PAD_TO_EVEN vs EXPLICIT leading-zero policy; lossless reconstruction; variable depth 1..N; prefix-tree insert/lookup/common-prefix/ancestry/siblings/compare; the three 01|65|89|27|{43,63,83} vectors verified line-like (terminal step 20). Conforms to source_route_core.schema.json.
negative_results: Malformed input is refused (wrong token count, non-digit, odd length under EXPLICIT), never silently repaired.
A parsed route is an exact arithmetic re-expression of the operator's digit string, not a decoded location.

claims.statement: The five-token base-100 route parses, reconstructs, and supports prefix operations exactly and reversibly.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public routes only; no private source narrative, no personal identifiers.
